headline: Tesla FSD fleet crosses 10 billion cumulative miles — Musk's own threshold for 'safe unsupervised' driving; fleet logging ~29M mi/day, up from 14M/day at start of year; analysts note milestone alone doesn't flip the autonomy switch but significantly strengthens the data case for v15

California enacts new law holding Cybercab and Robotaxi operators liable for ticketable violations — takes effect July 1; driverless fleet has no human to absorb legal accountability; unsupervised consumer FSD still targeted Q4 2026

EU regulatory clarity emerging as key 2026 Tesla catalyst — Sweden joins Netherlands in approving FSD Supervised; analysts cite EU subscriber ramp as 'good news' investors are underpricing; major ramp still gated to FSD V15 (est. 2027)

Tesla robotaxi mass-scale expansion gated to FSD V15 — execs confirm wide deployment won't proceed until V15 architectural overhaul (est. late 2026–early 2027); 5 cities still pending 1H ramp: Phoenix, Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Las Vegas
TSLA surges to $397.82 intraday high on May 1 — highest level since March 2026; closed $390.82 (+2.41%); market cap $1.47T on volume of 65.2M shares

FSD v14 Light now rolling out globally for broader fleet — supervised-only v14 architecture expanding reach to wider hardware; bridges gap ahead of HW3 V14 Lite (end of June target); Grok wake word, Smart Summon upgrade included in 2026.14.3 rollout wave

Fremont Optimus retool begins early May — Model S/X production lines shutting down now; Musk confirmed 'at least a few months' to dismantle + install Optimus line; first robots targeted for late July or August; Fremont converting to 1M robot/yr gen-1 capacity

Tesla 10-K/A reveals $573M web of transactions between Elon Musk's companies — $573M revenue from SpaceX + xAI sales in 2025; Tesla's $2B xAI investment converted to SpaceX shares after SpaceX acquired xAI; analysts flagging conflict-of-interest risk as xAI and SpaceX move closer together
